NUMCOMPSIM PRIVACY POLICY
Effective date: November 5, 2026

1. About the App
NumCompSim is a free educational Android application developed by Yuriy Galyaminsky. It is intended for children aged 6 to 12 and helps them practice mathematical skills. This policy describes how data may be processed when using the application.

2. Information Provided by Users
Mathematical exercises do not require registration or the submission of a name, email address, phone number, or other contact information. Core gameplay is available without an internet connection.

3. Firebase Analytics
The application uses Google Analytics for Firebase to understand how NumCompSim is used and to improve the application. The service may automatically process usage events, session information, app and operating system versions, device characteristics, an app instance identifier, and approximate location inferred from network information. Data is processed by Google services under their applicable policies.
The application is configured to exclude the Android Advertising ID (AD_ID) permission, disable Advertising ID collection through Firebase Analytics, and disable ad personalization signals. The application does not show personalized advertising to children.
More information: https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy

4. Google Play Games Services
The application includes an integration with Google Play Games Services. Depending on the service configuration and Google account settings, Google may process technical information and Play Games profile data. Signing in to Play Games is not required to complete mathematical exercises.
Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

5. Children's Privacy
The application does not require children to provide their names, photographs, contacts, addresses, or other personal details to solve exercises. The developer does not sell user data or use analytics for personalized advertising to children. The third-party services described above may process technical data. Parents and legal guardians may send privacy-related inquiries to the email address below.

6. Permissions
The application uses internet access permission for integrated Google services. Core gameplay does not request access to the camera, microphone, contacts, precise location, or personal files.

7. Data Sharing, Retention, and Deletion
Technical information and usage events may be sent to Google through Firebase Analytics and Google Play Games Services. Retention and deletion of data processed by these services depend on their policies and settings. Uninstalling the application does not necessarily immediately delete data previously processed by third-party services. For questions about data processing or requests to delete data accessible to the developer, contact the email address below.

8. Security
The developer aims to limit data processing to necessary purposes. No method of electronic data transmission or storage can guarantee absolute security.

9. Changes to This Policy
This policy may be updated when the application, third-party services, or applicable requirements change. The current version will be published by the developer.

10. Contact
Developer: Yuriy Galyaminsky
Email: galyaminsky@gmail.com

NUMCOMPSIM TERMS & CONDITIONS
Effective date: November 5, 2026

1. Introduction
NumCompSim is a free educational Android application for practicing mathematical skills, developed by Yuriy Galyaminsky. The application is intended for children aged 6–12. These Terms & Conditions govern its use. Parents and legal guardians are encouraged to review these terms together with children using the app.

2. Purpose and Availability
NumCompSim provides math practice through game-like exercises. It does not replace school instruction or professional teaching and does not guarantee a particular learning outcome.
The application is free to use. The current version does not offer paid subscriptions or in-app purchases. Core mathematical exercises work without an internet connection. Some integrated Google services may require network access.

3. Permitted Use
Users may install and use the application for personal, non-commercial purposes. Users must not use it for unlawful purposes or interfere with the operation of the application or its integrated services. Rights in the software, name, and other protected materials belong to their respective owners. These terms do not grant permission to distribute modified copies of the application or use its branding without authorization. These restrictions do not override rights granted under applicable law or the licenses of third-party components.

4. Third-Party Services and Data
The application integrates Google Analytics for Firebase and Google Play Games Services. These services may process technical information and application usage data under their own terms and policies. Registration or sign-in to Google Play Games is not required to complete mathematical exercises.
For details on data processing, refer to the NumCompSim Privacy Policy. Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy. Firebase privacy information: https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy.

5. Children and Parents
NumCompSim is designed for children aged 6–12. The application does not require a child to provide their name, phone number, address, or email address to complete math exercises. Parents and legal guardians may contact the developer about the application and data handling.

6. Updates and Changes
The developer may fix defects, update the visual design, add exercises, and release new versions. Availability of updates depends on the device, Android version, and app store availability. If these terms change materially, a revised version will be published with an updated effective date.

7. Availability and Liability
The developer aims to keep NumCompSim functioning properly, but some features may be temporarily unavailable due to technical problems, device limitations, or third-party services. The app is provided as available without a promise of uninterrupted or error-free operation. Nothing in these terms limits mandatory consumer rights or liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law.

8. Stopping Use
Users may stop using NumCompSim at any time by uninstalling it. Uninstalling the app does not necessarily cause information previously processed by third-party services to be deleted immediately; see the Privacy Policy for details.
